info.name: Libraro Learner API Collection
info.description: Complete Postman collection for Libraro Learner App endpoints. Features automatic bearer token extraction upon successful login.

request.description: Fetches general learner app settings including app versions, force update, terms, privacy policy, and support contact information.

exec: console.log('Learner token automatically saved to learner_token: ' + jsonData.token);

request.description: Self-service learner login. Username ('uid'): UID or Email. Password ('mobile'): Registered mobile number. Requires device-type and device-token headers. Enforces single-device login.
Fetch available plans for a specific branch using its public UUID.
Browse branch seat map. Occupants PII/financial data is sanitized for privacy.
Get available shifts/plan types for a branch or specific seat.
Calculate pricing, discounts, and breakdown for a seat booking.
Calculate chargeable days and calculated plan end date.
List remaining available seats with open shifts.
Public guest booking endpoint. Creates a pending booking row awaiting staff verification.
Allows an authenticated learner to change their login mobile / password credentials.

formdata.description: Image file (jpg, jpeg, png, webp - max 3MB). Can also use 'image' or 'profile_picture'.

request.description: Uploads a photo to temporary storage and returns temp_path and url. Pass the returned temp_path to profile/update API.

Update profile details and avatar. Matches library/learners/operation process:
- Binary File Upload: Send multipart/form-data with profile_picture_image (file)
- Temp Path String: Send JSON with profile_picture: 'upload/temp/...'
- Remove Image: Send remove_profile_picture: true or profile_picture: '' / null
Fetch learner dashboard data (full plan history, branch features, learner requests).
Get detailed history, transaction history, and seat allocations for authenticated learner.
Fetch notifications list supporting tabs ('all', 'active', 'expired'), unread counts, and attachment URLs.
Mark a single notification by UUID or all notifications ('all') as read for the authenticated learner.
Fetch learner's seat subscriptions and membership plans with tab filtering ('all', 'active', 'upcoming', 'expired'), progress bars, days used, and receipt links.
Fetch payment transactions history with status badges ('SUCCESS', 'PENDING', 'FAILED') and receipt download URLs.
Fetch attendance summary for date range.
Fetch punch in/out timestamps log for specified date.
Punch IN or OUT by scanning the library's live rotating attendance QR code.
Renew current seat/subscription plan. Payment modes: 1=online, 2=offline, 3=paylater.
Revoke active Sanctum tokens across all devices and log out.
